title: Presidents at War
description:
A Call to Valor
Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon, Carter, Bush, Ford, Reagan and Eisenhower experience war in the European and Pacific theaters, starting in December 1941 through late 1943.

title: Presidents at War
description:
Their Finest Hours
The experiences of Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon, Carter, Bush, Ford, Reagan and Eisenhower from D-Day to the final Pacific Island hopping campaigns, and how it shapes them as leaders.

title: Gettysburg
description: Comprised of footage from the 130th anniversary reenactment of the Battle of Gettysburg in 1993.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E04 — Civil War Cannoneers; Night Vision; Clearing a Minefield

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E03 — The Freemason Factor
The Freemasons are rumored to be able to trace their roots back to the medieval warrior monks known as the Knights Templar, and it is a fact that they were highly influential in the founding of the United States.

title: America's Book of Secrets: Special
description:
S01 E07 — Home Sweet Fortress
For some Americans, home is not behind a picket fence because it is behind steel bars, reinforced concrete, and even armed guards.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E11 — The Pentagon
The epicenter of American military operations is exposed, including how secrets are protected, and how 9/11 compromised top-secret information within.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E09 — West Point
The complex selection process, secret rituals and special training each cadet experiences at the renowned institution of West Point.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S03 E04 — The Gold Conspiracy
The world surrounding gold, the highly prized metal, and why people go will go to great lengths to obtain it.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E05 — The Hunt for Hitler's Relics
Adolf Hitler was deeply into the occult and even established a Nazi organization called the Ahnenerbe, with a secret mission to track down and confiscate holy relics.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E02 — Caesar
Overcoming overwhelming odds fighting throughout the Mediterranean, Caesar's decisive actions bring him massive success and make him the most powerful man in the world; every gambler knows that luck runs out eventually.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E03 — Cleopatra
The enigmatic Egyptian Queen Cleopatra's untold true story is one of a ruthless genius, doing anything necessary to cling onto power in the face of an aggressively expanding Roman Empire.

title: Ancient Top 10
description:
S01 E07 — Ancient Greek Tech
The ancient Greeks invented an ancient death ray, automatic doors and even robotics.

title: Ancient Top 10
description:
S01 E06 — Ancient Mysteries
An ancient computer, models that demonstrate flight, the transportation of massive stones and more mysteries from the ancient world.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E05 — Maximum Security
No problem has loomed larger for history's crazy rich than how to keep themselves and their multi-million dollar homes safe and secure; these three figures broke the bank on security features designed to prevent break-ins.

title: What Went Down
description:
S01 E04 — Custer's Last Stand
Archaeologist Doug Scott helps filmmakers re-create the Battle of the Little Bighorn to provide insight into what happened at Custer's Last Stand.

title: The Spanish-American War: First Intervention
description: Examining the war's origins, the battles and the outcome.

title: Custer's Last Man: I Survived Little Big Horn
description: New evidence confirms that a man named Finkle was the lone white survivor of Custer's Last Stand.
